workload.selection_rule: reads > 0; reads * estimated_decode_ns(current chain) > threshold; a standalone representation decodes strictly faster and is not larger than the logical bytes

economics.rule: policy break-even reads = ceil(threshold / old_decode_ns); storage break-even reads = ceil((new_physical_bytes - old_physical_bytes) / (old_decode_ns - new_decode_ns))

notes: One process at a time; page cache is warm for the timed reads.
The before-rebase snapshot pins the old delta frames, so the after-rebase retained-byte total includes both representations.
Per-tensor read times are medians of 5 reads after one warm-up read; absolute times are host- and cache-dependent.

The calibration was measured with the release build in this court; it is not portable to another host.
